description: Purchase or resume a prepaid access pass for the UUID configured in the MCP client Authorization header. The fixed price is 2 USDC for 30 days of unlimited jq queries and zero application query logs; each renewal is a separate purchase after expiration. Use only when paid access is wanted; use get_quota to inspect active access first. An active pass returns its status without charging again. Discovery and status checks are free. Expired paid UUIDs reject ordinary queries until renewed or explicitly paid per query and never fall back to tracked free access, even after old billing records are deleted. Browser wallet checkout and private MCP settings are available at https://thejqapi.com/access; ordinary MCP clients need no wallet after payment. Requires an x402-capable client with a funded wallet and an explicit spending policy allowing 2 USDC. The initial tool error contains standard x402 v2 PaymentRequired data. Retry with the signed payment in request _meta["x402/payment"], never in arguments. The optional purchase_id resumes an earlier order; keep the same order on retries. The UUID remains a secret bearer credential and must never be included in arguments. Returns active status or a purchase_id, settlement status, transaction receipt, and expires_at when activated. A pending settlement must be checked again without a new payment. Invalid input is 400, missing UUID 401, unavailable purchase 404, conflicting or expired order 409, and disabled/unavailable billing 503. Purchases are live with native USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). The pass preserves 5 MiB document and 15-minute upload limits. Minimal billing/access records and explicitly requested uploads are retained separately. Payments are public onchain; Cloudflare infrastructure policies apply. GET https://thejqapi.com/pricing reports current availability.

purchase_id.description: Optional purchase_id returned by an earlier purchase attempt. Reuse it to resume that purchase or recover its receipt; omit to create or resume the caller’s open purchase. This is not your UUID bearer credential.
